interpretation: SpecialAvatarID and world_level identify the client-side source trial relic builder.
RelicPropertyType and RelicPropertyTypeExtra resolve declared relic sets.
RelicMainValue and RelicSubValue resolve aggregate AvatarPropertyType values, summed by the native builder.
OverrideProperty uses the separate AbilityProperty enum.
No ordinary owned relic affixes or accepted game UI are inferred.
The source trial lookup first reads world level zero, then branches on a row flag before using the supplied world level.
